knowledge:
- key_parameters: retRes=logical indicating whether to return intermediate results and metadata (e.g., top gene pairs in cxds) ;; verb=logical indicating whether to print progress messages during bcds execution
- alternatives: cxds (co-expression based, uses binary presence/absence of gene pairs) vs bcds (uses full count information and artificial doublets) vs cxds_bcds_hybrid (combines both for optimal performance)
- when_to_use: When analyzing single-cell RNA-seq data to identify and filter out doublet cells (multiplets) that can bias downstream clustering and differential expression analyses.
- pitfalls: The package expects raw counts to be stored in the "counts" assay of a SingleCellExperiment object (i.e., assay(sce, "counts")). Using normalized or log-transformed counts as the primary input to these functions is not supported.

workflows.name: doublet_annotation
workflows.intent: Annotate and score doublets in single-cell RNA-seq data using co-expression, binary classification, and hybrid approaches.
input: sce (SingleCellExperiment object containing raw counts in the "counts" assay)
workflows.stages: 1. Run co-expression based doublet scoring (cxds) ;; 2. Run binary classification based doublet scoring (bcds) ;; 3. Run the hybrid doublet scoring approach (cxds_bcds_hybrid) ;; 4. Extract top gene pairs driving the co-expression doublet annotations
workflows.code:
sce = cxds(sce,retRes = TRUE)
sce = bcds(sce,retRes = TRUE,verb=TRUE)
sce = cxds_bcds_hybrid(sce)
scds =
top3 = metadata(sce)$cxds$topPairs[1:3,]
rs   = rownames(sce)
hb   = rowData(sce)$cxds_hvg_bool
ho   = rowData(sce)$cxds_hvg_ordr[hb]
hgs  = rs[ho]
